messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

context.description: The context or scenario in which the question is being asked, providing additional information to the user.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the **long‑weekend periods** in Canada for the calendar year 2023 (i.e., the days that give you a three‑day break because a federal holiday falls on a Friday, Monday, or is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend):

| Long‑Weekend | Dates (2023) | Holiday(s) |
|--------------|--------------|------------|
| New Year’s | **Jan 1 – 3** | New Year’s Day (observed Mon Jan 2) |
| Family Day (Ontario) | **Feb 18 – 20** | Family Day (Mon Feb 20) |
| Good Friday | **Apr 7 – 9** | Good Friday (Fri Apr 7) |
| Victoria Day | **May 20 – 22** | Victoria Day (Mon May 22) |
| Canada Day | **Jul 1 – 3** | Canada Day (Sat Jul 1, observed Mon Jul 3) |
| Labour Day | **Sep 2 – 4** | Labour Day (Mon Sep 4) |
| Thanksgiving | **Oct 7 – 9** | Thanksgiving (Mon Oct 9) |
| Remembrance Day | **Nov 11 – 13** | Remembrance Day (Sat Nov 11, observed Mon Nov 13) |
| Christmas | **Dec 23 – 25** | Christmas Day (Mon Dec 25) |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces have their own “Family Day” or other holidays that may create additional long weekends (e.g., Family Day in Alberta on the 3rd Monday of February, or the “St. Patrick’s Day” holiday in Newfoundland & Labrador).  
> • The table above lists the federal holidays that generate long weekends across the country. If you need province‑specific dates, let me know!
